note: All story definitions are candidates. Human-readable eligibility gates must be implemented as typed guards; no headline may render without verified values. The generic card headline is a template, not a claim of a measured result.

stories.headline: THE DISTANCE YOU RAN
stories.claim_guard: 2025 distance is valid only if all eligible run activities have usable distance

stories.headline: ONE RUN WENT FURTHER
stories.claim_guard: largest recorded run, not a certified personal record

stories.headline: YOUR FASTEST COMPARABLE RUN
stories.eligibility: at least 3 runs, distance>=3km; GPS or calibrated pace
stories.claim_guard: like-for-like distance and route conditions; no general speed improvement claim

stories.headline: WEEKS IN YOUR RUNNING SHOES
stories.eligibility: at least 8 run weeks; full year
stories.claim_guard: count unique ISO weeks with running

stories.headline: WHEN YOUR RUNS HAPPENED
stories.eligibility: at least 10 runs; dominant time bucket>=40%

stories.headline: YOUR RUNNING ENGINE
stories.claim_guard: HR zone settings may change; use only validated compatible zones

stories.headline: YOUR RUNNING RHYTHM
stories.claim_guard: running cadence units device-specific and FIT developer fields normalized

stories.headline: THE HILLS ADDED UP
stories.claim_guard: do not include treadmill elevation unless recorded as valid

stories.headline: ALL THE PATHS YOU TOOK
stories.eligibility: at least 3 valid GPS runs; privacy permission
stories.claim_guard: never publicly expose start/end or precise trace by default

stories.headline: THE RUNS THAT STOOD OUT
stories.eligibility: actual PR markers; corroborated with category
stories.claim_guard: PR flag is not evidence of which distance record

stories.headline: YOU LEFT THE ROAD BEHIND
stories.eligibility: trail subtype >=3; entire running classification reliable
stories.claim_guard: trail vs road breakdown only when subtype truly known

stories.headline: KILOMETERS ON TWO WHEELS
stories.claim_guard: separate indoor credited trainer kilometers from GPS outdoors

stories.headline: TIME IN THE SADDLE
stories.claim_guard: do not turn elapsed time into pedaling time

stories.headline: THE WATTS YOU PUT DOWN
stories.claim_guard: FIT power data optional; no FTP claim without supported test

stories.headline: THE ROADS YOU EXPLORED
stories.claim_guard: avoid revealing home and routine routes

stories.headline: HOW YOU RODE
stories.eligibility: >=6 rides, indoor and outdoor accurately classified
stories.claim_guard: do not imply preference from indoor vs outdoor alone

stories.headline: DID YOUR RIDING SPEED CHANGE?
stories.eligibility: matched outdoor course conditions; >=6 paired sessions
stories.claim_guard: wind/terrain/traffic make naive mean speed misleading

stories.headline: THE MINUTES THAT COUNTED
stories.claim_guard: do not assume all minutes were hard effort

stories.headline: TIME IN THE RED
stories.claim_guard: zones 4 and 5, not necessarily actual max exertion

stories.headline: THE BIGGEST HEART-RATE PEAK
stories.claim_guard: not proof of maximum physiological heart rate

stories.headline: HOW YOUR HEART SETTLED
stories.eligibility: >=3 FIT sessions with intervals and continuous HR
stories.claim_guard: observed recovery between intervals, not medical fitness conclusion

stories.headline: THE WEEKLY RITUAL
stories.claim_guard: no moral judgement on missed weeks

stories.headline: YOUR LONGEST HIIT SESSION
stories.claim_guard: long session is not higher intensity

stories.headline: YOUR BIGGEST HIIT DAY
stories.claim_guard: multiple sessions may reflect duplicate imports; dedupe first

stories.headline: THE FORMAT YOU RETURNED TO

stories.headline: MORE THAN JUST A TIMER

stories.headline: EVERY REP COUNTS

stories.headline: THE HEAVIEST RECORDED SET
